custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a Part Library entry with no part behind it for this test, entry A: create a part at the test location, then delete it, so the entry stays with "Total parts" 0.
  • Start on the Part Library page (Parts in the top bar, then Part Library in the left menu).

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C154833 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154833-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00. Click Save.
  2. Delete part A, so only its Part Library entry stays: On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154833-A, click its row, then click Delete Part. The part goes at once; its Part Library entry stays with Total parts 0.
